title: Accelerating discovery in organic redox flow batteries
source_summary: The text emphasizes the importance of collaborative research and the integration of computation with experimentation to accelerate advancements in organic redox flow battery research, with potential benefits extending beyond energy storage.
abstract: We highlight the challenges and opportunities in organic redox flow battery research, underscoring the need for collaborative research efforts. The synergy between computation and experimentation holds the potential to expedite progress in this field and can have far-reaching impacts beyond energy storage applications.
